description: This file contains benchmarking code for scaled dot product attention (SDPA) in a transformer model, including experiment configuration, execution, and result reporting.

classes.name: ExperimentConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for a transformer attention experiment, including batch size, number of heads, sequence lengths, embedding dimension, data type, backend, and device.

classes.name: ExperimentResults
classes.description: Stores the results of an experiment, including forward and backward times and TFLOPS.

classes.name: Experiment
classes.description: Combines an ExperimentConfig and ExperimentResults into a single object with a method to convert to dictionary.

methods.name: benchmark_cuda_function_in_microseconds
methods.description: Runs a CUDA function and measures execution time in microseconds.

methods.name: benchmark_torch_function_in_microseconds
methods.description: Warms up and benchmarks a torch function, returning median execution time in microseconds.

methods.name: calculate_tflops
methods.description: Calculates TFLOPS for scaled dot product attention based on configuration and execution time.

methods.name: get_input
methods.description: Generates random input tensors for the experiment based on configuration.

methods.name: run_single_experiment
methods.description: Runs attention forward and backward passes, measures times, and computes TFLOPS.

methods.name: print_results
methods.description: Prints experiment results in a tabular format.

methods.name: write_results_to_csv
methods.description: Saves experiment results to a timestamped CSV file.

methods.name: generate_experiment_configs
methods.description: Creates a list of experiment configurations with various parameter combinations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to run all experiments, print, and save results.
